<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/organizations/{organizationId}/users"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the organization's credentials, newest first, one page at a time.

Pass `limit` and follow the `next` link in the `Link` header for the following page. Without
`limit`, a page holds up to 2,000 credentials, which today returns most organizations' whole
list in one response; that default may be lowered.

**Each credential in the response includes its password in clear text**, along with a
ready-made connection string. That is deliberate: we store passwords so the dashboard can
display and rotate them. It does mean this response is as sensitive as a password file, so
avoid logging it and never pass it to an untrusted client.
